notes: ὁ μικρότερος: the article keeps only the pronoun 'he' and the adjective carries 'that is but little', on rule 32's principle that the predicate is what the relative clause is predicated of. Giving the discontinuous 'he … that' to the article on rule 31's prepositional-phrase carve-out remains defensible; the contract does not settle an adjectival modifier either way.
γεννητοῖς is anarthrous, so the antecedent, relativizer and copula are all its own helpers, as rule 92's anarthrous examples have it.
τῶν οὐρανῶν leaves its article unrepresented under rule 23, the ASV writing 'of heaven' with no determiner.
